problems.title: Rotate Image
problems.keyInsight: Rotate 90 clockwise = Transpose + Reverse each row.

code.python:
def rotate(matrix):
    n = len(matrix)
    for i in range(n):  # transpose
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            matrix[i][j], matrix[j][i] = matrix[j][i], matrix[i][j]
    for row in matrix:  # reverse rows
        row.reverse()

problems.title: Set Matrix Zeroes
problems.keyInsight: Use first row and first column as markers. O(1) extra space.

code.python:
def myPow(x, n):
    if n < 0: x, n = 1/x, -n
    result = 1
    while n:
        if n % 2: result *= x
        x *= x
        n //= 2
    return result
